sd:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production-ready static chibi SD character sprite for a collectible RPG ICON card named 나무늘봉순.
Input images: image 1 is the reference for this adult woman's facial identity, straight black hair with bangs, and gray-lilac sleeveless clothing only. Image 2 is a style/proportion reference ONLY: coherent 2D anime chibi drawing and painterly finish. Do not copy image 2's face, hair, medical armor, cross, syringe, pose or accessories.
Primary request: draw a NEW full-body standing character with about 2.7-head chibi proportions, preserving the recognizable facial structure and gentle expression of image 1 in the SAME 2D drawing style as the body. Long black hair with soft wispy bangs; smooth natural connected strands from roots to tips, not chunky plates, bands or staircase layers. Eyes, nose, mouth, hands, body and clothing must share consistent line weight, stylization, shadow edges and painterly finish; never paste a photographic face.
Clothing: retain the cool gray-lilac sleeveless top, finish it as an elegant modest lilac-gray short fantasy dress with a small silver waist clasp and simple matching ankle boots. Adult character, cute compact proportions, no sexualization. No extra character.
Pose: standing in a new balanced three-quarter pose facing slightly right, both feet fully visible, left hand loosely resting near the waist, right palm gently open at waist height, natural hands. Do not copy the seated photograph or its hand-to-face pose. The skill is Return Oath, a conditional ally revival, but do not bake any magic effect into this character sprite.
Composition: centered entire character within a SQUARE transparent canvas, generous transparent margins on all sides, silhouette occupies at most 84% of canvas height, no cropped hair or shoes. Clean separate game sprite, readable at small battle size. Soft neutral light, refined 2D anime plus painterly shading, no photoreal skin or 3D doll.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no floor, no scenery, no shadow plate. No text, watermark, border, frame, UI, second pose, sprite sheet, weapons, medical insignia or glowing FX.
fx:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RPG skill VFX sprite atlas, RETURN OATH / conditional ally revival.
Primary request: one SQUARE transparent PNG containing EXACTLY 16 DISTINCT animation frames in a precise 4-column by 4-row uniform grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every cell has the same dimensions and centered registration; no gutters drawn, no numbers, text, borders or contact sheet background.
Effect: a delicate silver-white and muted lilac luminous oath knot woven from flowing light threads, opening into a life-restoring bloom of light with petal-shaped wisps and warm pearl sparks. Only the magic itself, NO person, body, item, floor or scene. Painterly 2D game VFX, crisp readable silhouette and fine feathered light trails, no flat geometric UI diagram.
Animation sequence with genuinely different evolving shapes: frame 1 small separate pearl motes; 2-4 the motes draw curving threads; 5-7 threads weave into a luminous closed oath knot; 8-9 the knot tightens and ignites; frame 10 is the strong resurrection flash and first opening petals; 11-13 unfurl the bright life bloom with distinct rising light ribbons; 14-16 ribbons break into diminishing floating petals and sparks. Maintain center throughout. This must be 16 unique hand-animated states, not identical icons or a simple opacity/rotation progression.
Production constraints: EVERY frame completely contained inside the central 76% of its own cell, at least 12% fully transparent padding to ALL four edges of EVERY cell so no trails touch or cross cell boundaries. Actual transparent alpha throughout unused pixels; no opaque black/white/checkerboard background. No character, words, frame labels, chart lines, border, watermark or extra panels.
